en: José Rizal knew twenty-two languages, far more than the average person, and he was only thirty-five years old when he was executed.
The Philippine Senate has twenty-four elected members, whereas the Supreme Court consists of fifteen justices, including one Chief Justice and fourteen Associate Justices.
Although the Philippines has over one hundred eighty distinct languages, only Tagalog and Cebuano have more than twenty million native speakers each.
Proclaimed on June 12, 1898, Philippine Independence means the nation celebrated its 125th anniversary in 2023, marking one hundred twenty-five years of sovereignty.
The Philippine eagle, our national bird, boasts a wingspan of up to two meters, which is wider than an average ten-year-old child's height.
The Philippines has about one hundred ten indigenous groups, and the Lumad of Mindanao alone comprise over eighteen distinct ethnolinguistic communities.
Dr. Fe del Mundo was the first woman admitted to Harvard Medical School in 1936, and she lived to be one hundred two years old.
The Cebu Sinulog festival features a specific two-step forward and one-step backward dance, attracting over one million tourists annually to honor the Santo Niño.
Article III of the 1987 Constitution contains the Bill of Rights, which lists exactly fourteen sections detailing the fundamental civil liberties of Filipino citizens.
The traditional bayanihan practice involves a community of up to one hundred people physically carrying a nipa hut weighing over one thousand kilograms.
Juan Luna's masterpiece Spoliarium measures 4.22 meters by 7.01 meters, making its massive canvas roughly the size of a small classroom wall.
The Philippines is divided into eighty-one provinces, which are organized into seventeen administrative regions, including the highly urbanized National Capital Region.
